summary: The agent failed test_legacy_node_checks because it applied Harbor-specific fixed row positions (13-16) to a rights rollforward workbook where control row positions vary per detail sheet. The existing excel-workbook-construction skill over-specifies Harbor row numbers as if they were universal. This update generalizes the control row positioning logic, adds dynamic row calculation rules, and introduces a cross-sheet reference verification step that catches summary-to-control-row mismatches before saving.
